source: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Behoerde fuer Umwelt und Energie: Naturdenkmale (nr_f_naturdenkmal layer of the Schutzgebiete WFS)
licence_proof: The WFS GetCapabilities response (ows:Fees element) states verbatim: 'Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0, Quellenvermerk: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Behoerde fuer Umwelt und Energie' (fetched from the live GetCapabilities response, 2026-08-13).
designation: Naturdenkmal (Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg), layer de.hh.up:nr_f_naturdenkmal within the city's Schutzgebiete WFS
attribution: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg, Behoerde fuer Umwelt und Energie (required by DL-DE-BY 2.0)
scope: ALL 12 features in Hamburg's entire Naturdenkmal layer, fetched in full (no pagination needed, the whole city-wide category is only 12 entries). Filtered NONE out at import time; the semantic filter (collectible individual trees vs ponds/moors/geological features) is recorded per entry via 'hektar' and 'feature_text' for a verification pass to apply, since only 2 of the 12 are trees.
caveat: Hamburg's Naturdenkmal category is overwhelmingly NOT trees: of 12 entries, 10 are ponds, moors, a clay pit and a canal ('Papenbrack', 'Kiebitzmoor', 'Sievertsche Tongrube', 'Poppenbuettler Graben' etc, 0.17 to 10.5 hectares each), which fail the semantic filter for a collectible tree point outright and must not be imported as tree candidates. Only 2 are genuinely individual trees, both under 0.005 ha: 'Alter Schwede' (a well-known old oak, HH-1011/gebietsnummer 3) and 'Eibe am Neulaender Deich' (a yew). Geometry is a small POLYGON around the tree/crown, not a single point coordinate: a verification pass should compute the centroid or read the polygon's extent as the trunk position, and treat the resulting precision as 'approximate' unless corroborated by a second, tree-level source. No species field (species must come from the name/feature_text or external verification), no age field, no vitality field: 'Alter Schwede' literally means 'Old Swede' and is a nickname, not evidence of age by itself. 'verordnung' is the ordinance date (1936 for Papenbrack), same planting-date trap as Berlin/Bayern: it is when the tree was DECLARED protected, not planted.

Hamburg.note: Thin: only 'Alter Schwede' and 'Eibe am Neulaender Deich' pass the semantic filter out of the whole state-wide Naturdenkmal layer. Below the 'no pass under six candidates' floor on its own; useful as two free leads for whenever a Hamburg pass runs with other sourcing (e.g. Alster park trees, Stadtpark, Planten un Blomen found by the normal search order), not as a register that carries a Hamburg city page by itself. Hamburg's separate Strassenbaumkataster (street tree cadastre) is a full municipal inventory and fails the semantic filter outright per BRIEF_RESEARCH.md/CLAUDE.md's standing rule against bulk imports.
